title: The quotient of a polynomial ring by a monic polynomial is free with the power basis
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f\in R[T]$ monic of degree $n$. Then $R[T]/(f)$ is a free $R$-module with basis the classes of $1,T,\dots,T^{n-1}$; in particular it is a finite $R$-algebra, and for every ideal $I\subset R$ one has $(R[T]/(f))/I(R[T]/(f))\cong(R/I)[T]/(\overline f)$.
